content_sections.heading: AIIMS Jodhpur Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. AIIMS/JDH/NR-Res./Adv./005 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download AIIMS Jodhpur notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Other conditions: All educational, professional and technical qualifications must be from a recognized Board/University and full-time Experience must be acquired after obtaining the minimum educational qualification for the post Desirable: Previous experience of working in research projects Proficiency in Hindi and English language Valid driving license and willingness to travel as per project requirement using a two-wheeler and/or four-wheeler

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for AIIMS Jodhpur Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates reporting after 10:00 AM on the interview day will not be entertained Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Tenure of 5 months Purely temporary/contractual basis, co-terminus with the project No right to claim permanent employment under AIIMS Jodhpur or continuation in any other project Post may increase/decrease as per requirement at the sole discretion of the Research Section, AIIMS Jodhpur

content_sections.heading: How Will AIIMS Jodhpur Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Screening / Scrutiny Test (may be conducted depending on the number of applicants) Walk-in Interview The Competent Authority reserves the right to conduct a Screening/Scrutiny Test depending on the number of applicants

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Duly filled application in the prescribed format Bio-data All relevant original documents One set of self-attested photocopies of documents regarding age, qualifications and relevant experience Essential qualification and experience certificates enclosed with the application form No Objection Certificate for persons working in Govt. or Public Sector undertaking

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS Jodhpur Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Fill the application in the prescribed format given in the notice (Format for Application). Report at the venue at 09:00 AM on 17-11-2026; reporting closes at 10:00 AM. Submit the duly filled application and Bio-data on the day of the walk-in interview. Appear in person with all relevant original documents and one set of self-attested photocopies regarding age, qualifications and experience. Enclose all essential qualification and experience certificates with the application form.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be admissible to appear in the interview Salary is consolidated without any other benefits and is based on experience, qualifications and skill set No enquiries shall be entertained after the due date Application without essential qualification and experience certificates will be considered incomplete

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for AIIMS Jodhpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 17 November 2026, and candidates report at 9:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in AIIMS Jodhpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Accountant (UDC).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for AIIMS Jodhpur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 17 November 2026 at 9:00 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 30 years (as on the last date of the advertisement). Relaxation: Service in other research projects Age concession to the extent of service rendered in other research projects may be admissible for experienced and skilled persons on a case-to-case basis (only applicable for ICMR projects).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs 23,000 per month (consolidated).

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: M.Com. or equivalent from a recognized University.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. All educational, professional and technical qualifications must be from a recognized Board/University and full-time. Experience must be acquired after obtaining the minimum educational qualification for the post.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates reporting after 10:00 AM on the interview day will not be entertained. Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Screening / Scrutiny Test (may be conducted depending on the number of applicants). Walk-in Interview. The Competent Authority reserves the right to conduct a Screening/Scrutiny Test depending on the number of applicants.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Tenure of 5 months. Purely temporary/contractual basis, co-terminus with the project. No right to claim permanent employment under AIIMS Jodhpur or continuation in any other project.
